system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global near real-time NO2 concentration from Sentinel-5P TROPOMI sensor with daily coverage. The Earth Engine collection provides global atmospheric nitrogen dioxide measurements.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily NO2 measurements from 2018-07-10 to present in the Earth Engine asset.
data_description.important_note: Nitrogen dioxide is a key air quality indicator. NO2 enters the atmosphere through fossil fuel combustion, biomass burning, and natural processes. This dataset provides near real-time monitoring capabilities for air pollution studies.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NO2 column number density in mol/m^2. Use tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density band for boundary layer pollution studies.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Filter by QA values and cloud fraction for reliable measurements. Negative values may occur over clean regions.

data_description.data_source: European Space Agency Sentinel-5P TROPOMI mission via Google Earth Engine
